title: Alpha Corp to acquire Beta Ltd
text: Alpha Corp agreed to acquire Beta Ltd for $500 million on 12 March 2024. The boards of both companies approved the deal, which remains subject to regulatory approval.
label: Acquisition

title: Gamma Holdings completes purchase of Delta Software
text: Gamma Holdings acquired Delta Software for EUR 220 million in cash, the company said on 3 June 2023. The transaction closed after all approvals were received.
label: Acquisition

title: Orion Foods buys snack maker Kettle Crunch
text: Orion Foods agreed to buy Kettle Crunch Inc. for 1.2 billion rupees, according to a statement dated 21 August 2024. Orion will own 100% of the business after closing.
label: Acquisition

title: Nimbus Cloud to purchase stake in Quarry AI
text: Nimbus Cloud announced it will acquire a 65% stake in Quarry AI for $85 million, subject to customary closing conditions.
label: Acquisition

title: Harbor Bank acquires Pinewood Savings
text: Harbor Bank has acquired Pinewood Savings in a transaction valued at $340 million, completed on 1 October 2022.
label: Acquisition

title: Crestline and Mapleton announce merger
text: Crestline Industries and Mapleton Group announced a merger of equals on 9 January 2024. The combined company will operate under the name CrestMaple.
label: Merger

title: Solaris Energy and Verdant Power to merge
text: Solaris Energy and Verdant Power agreed to merge in an all-share deal valued at about GBP 4 billion, the companies said on 15 May 2023.
label: Merger

title: Shareholders approve telecom merger
text: Shareholders of Lumen Telecom and Aria Mobile voted to approve the proposed merger on 27 November 2023. The merger is expected to close in the second quarter.
label: Merger

title: Medora Pharma and Zenith Biotech to combine
text: Medora Pharma and Zenith Biotech will combine in a merger that creates a company with annual revenue of $7 billion, they announced on 4 April 2024.
label: Merger

title: Airlines confirm merger talks
text: Skyway Airlines and Bluejet confirmed they are in merger talks, but no agreement has been reached, the carriers said on 18 July 2024.
label: Merger

title: Titan Group to sell logistics unit
text: Titan Group announced plans to sell its logistics subsidiary, Titan Freight, for $900 million on 2 February 2024.
label: Company Sale / Divestiture

title: Vega Corp divests mining assets
text: Vega Corp completed the sale of its coal mining assets to Redrock Resources for $450 million on 30 September 2023.
label: Company Sale / Divestiture

title: Kestrel Brands to divest consumer division
text: Kestrel Brands said on 11 March 2024 that it will divest its consumer products division to focus on its core pharmaceutical business.
label: Company Sale / Divestiture

title: Atlas Retail sells 40% stake in online arm
text: Atlas Retail agreed to sell a 40% stake in Atlas Online to Prime Ventures for INR 3,500 crore, it said on 8 December 2023.
label: Company Sale / Divestiture

title: Northwind to offload hotel chain
text: Northwind Hospitality agreed to sell its hotel chain Seaview Resorts to Coral Capital for $1.1 billion on 19 June 2024.
label: Company Sale / Divestiture

title: Falcon Industries rejects unsolicited bid
text: Falcon Industries rejected an unsolicited $6 billion takeover offer from Raptor Capital on 5 May 2024, calling the proposal inadequate. No deal was agreed.
label: Hostile Takeover / Attempted Takeover

title: Raptor launches hostile tender offer
text: Raptor Capital launched a hostile tender offer for Cobalt Chemicals at $42 per share on 20 January 2023, bypassing the board.
label: Hostile Takeover / Attempted Takeover

title: Cobalt Chemicals adopts poison pill
text: Cobalt Chemicals adopted a poison pill defense on 25 January 2023 to fend off an unwanted bid from Raptor Capital.
label: Hostile Takeover / Attempted Takeover

title: Summit Media drops takeover approach
text: Summit Media withdrew its takeover approach for Echo Broadcasting on 14 February 2024 after the board refused to engage.
label: Hostile Takeover / Attempted Takeover

title: Willow Stores board resists proposal
text: Granite Partners made an unsolicited proposal to buy Willow Stores for $2.3 billion, which the Willow board said it would not recommend, on 7 October 2023.
label: Hostile Takeover / Attempted Takeover

title: Zeta Motors appoints new CEO
text: Zeta Motors appointed Priya Raman as chief executive officer effective 1 April 2024, succeeding Mark Ellis, who retires.
label: Executive Change

title: Quantum Systems CFO resigns
text: Quantum Systems said chief financial officer David Chen resigned on 16 August 2023 and the company has begun a search for a successor.
label: Executive Change

title: Coastal Bank names new chairman
text: Coastal Bank named Elena Rossi as chairman of the board on 22 November 2023.
label: Executive Change

title: Helix Retail CEO steps down
text: Helix Retail CEO Tom Walker stepped down on 9 September 2024, and the board appointed Susan Park as interim CEO.
label: Executive Change

title: Pioneer Tech hires new CTO
text: Pioneer Tech announced it has hired Arjun Mehta as chief technology officer, starting 3 July 2023.
label: Executive Change

title: Omega Steel to cut 3,000 jobs
text: Omega Steel announced a restructuring plan on 13 March 2024 that will cut 3,000 jobs and close two plants.
label: Corporate Restructuring

title: Bright Telecom files for bankruptcy protection
text: Bright Telecom filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection on 6 June 2023 as part of a plan to restructure its debt of $2.5 billion.
label: Corporate Restructuring

title: Maple Autos reorganizes into three divisions
text: Maple Autos said it will reorganize into three business divisions and reduce management layers, effective 1 January 2025.
label: Corporate Restructuring

title: Ridge Pharma unveils cost-cutting programme
text: Ridge Pharma unveiled a cost-cutting programme on 28 April 2024 targeting savings of $300 million, including layoffs and site closures.
label: Corporate Restructuring

title: Lakeshore Foods restructures debt
text: Lakeshore Foods agreed with creditors on 12 December 2023 to restructure $800 million of debt and extend maturities to 2030.
label: Corporate Restructuring

title: Regulator blocks brewer merger
text: The Competition Authority blocked the proposed merger between Harlow Brewing and Dunmore Beverages on 10 June 2024, citing concerns about higher prices.
label: Regulatory Action

title: Securities regulator fines Ironbridge Capital
text: The securities regulator fined Ironbridge Capital $25 million on 3 March 2024 for misleading investors.
label: Regulatory Action

title: Antitrust approval for Orchid Health deal
text: The antitrust regulator approved Orchid Health's acquisition of Remedy Clinics on 17 September 2023, on the condition that it sells 12 clinics.
label: Regulatory Action

title: Central bank penalises Sunrise Finance
text: The central bank imposed a penalty of INR 5 crore on Sunrise Finance on 24 July 2023 for violating lending norms.
label: Regulatory Action

title: Watchdog opens probe into Apex Search
text: The competition watchdog opened an investigation into Apex Search on 29 May 2024 over alleged abuse of market dominance.
label: Regulatory Action

title: Brightwater quarterly profit rises
text: Brightwater Corp reported a 12% rise in quarterly profit to $1.4 billion on 25 October 2023, beating analyst estimates.
label: Other / No Relevant Corporate Event

title: Stocks close higher
text: Shares on major indices closed higher on 14 March 2024 as investors awaited the central bank's interest rate decision.
label: Other / No Relevant Corporate Event

title: Oil prices slip
text: Oil prices fell 2% on 2 August 2023 as demand concerns weighed on the market.
label: Other / No Relevant Corporate Event

title: Vertex Electronics launches smartphone line
text: Vertex Electronics launched its new smartphone line on 5 September 2024 priced from $499.
label: Other / No Relevant Corporate Event

title: Granville Insurance declares dividend
text: Granville Insurance declared a quarterly dividend of $0.45 per share on 18 January 2024.
label: Other / No Relevant Corporate Event
